sources.excerpt: Death Metal Chainsaw Distortion | LICHTLÆRM AUDIO Cart 0 News Artists About Contact Shop Back About FAQ Cart 0 News Artists About About FAQ Somic Doom Devices | handmade in Berlin Contact Shop Shop Medusa - Grinding Death Metal Distortion Next Ragnarøk - Apocalyptic Tube Distortion//Preamp Medusa - Grinding Death Metal Distortion Medusa - Grinding Death Metal Distortion €199.00 incl. EU VAT/Mwst., plus shipping The Medusa is the successor of the probably most infamous pedal we created during Lichtlaerms first life: the Breathe//Die. As a collaboration with local Berlin band “Breathe//Die” it was the first HM2-style pedal to feature a noise reduction circuit, boost and an extended feature set in a compact enclosure. These sold out within days and subsequently went on the used market for up to 600USD! As it’s been one of the most requested pedals for us to bring back to life we decided to not just re-launch but redesign the circuit to give you even more flexibility and the most cohesive package on the market! We took the first design and moved the boost into the core circuit resulting in up to three times the gain the classic chainsaw pedal offers you while also allowing you in to use our well-known cut control to shape the low end and create punchy palm mutes that the original was never capable of. We also increased the output immensely because… well: why not? With great power comes great responsibility: meaning with all the gain and high output volume you can’t avoid a certain level of noise. That’s why we added a full version of our Key & Gate into the circuit: being triggered from the input like you’d to with modern noise gates and placed behind the loop so anything you blend with the Medusa profits from the gate as well. Loop? Yes! Like our King in Yellow we decided to add a parallel fx-loop to Medusa that allows you to blend her gnarly distortion with any other device: distortion, boost, overdrive or even the preamp of your favorite tube amp - or just leave the loop empty and use it as a clean blend. Of course you can invert the phase of the loop to avoid phase cancellations or create interesting out-of-phase sounds. We decided to keep the traditional HM2 EQ bands named low & grind to give you easy access to the well known grindy sounds we all love but added a parallel mids control (200-700hz) and a shelving high filter to add or tame presence. Due to this Presence control the Medusa also lends itself perfectly to being used as a preamp! Last but not least we decided to throw in another switchable gain section: more modern, louder, more mid focused. So now you can decide between the filthy distortion of the black/orange box made famous in Sweden or a modern in-your-face kind of saturation that still has access to the infamous EQ of the HM2. Of course as always: we put all these features in the same compact box and put an amazing artwork made of real gold by the outstanding Kasia Jasmina on it! Get yours today and start tearing down walls and melting faces! For a detailed description of the controls please refer to the manual . Features: Lichtlaerm Audio Smart Relay technology Swedish Death Metal distortion 2 distinct, switchable gain stages extremely high output, more than twice as much gain as the original 4-band EQ with parametric mids full blackmer-vca noise gate Lichtlaerm-proprietary “cut”-control parallel fx-loop with polarity switch please keep in mind that all pedals are made to order and may take 14-20 days for production! HeadRUM!" Voir ses pédales Coup de cœur La Medusa de Lichtlærm Audio, marque artisanale berlinoise, réinvente la distorsion culte de la HM-2, véritable icône du metal extrême suédois. Plus qu’une simple réédition, cette pédale est le fruit d’un travail de repensée complète du circuit, pour offrir aux guitaristes une bombe de gain encore plus flexible et puissante. Succédant à la très recherchée « Breathe//Die » de la même marque (revendue jusqu’à 600 $ sur le marché de l’occasion !), la Medusa intègre désormais le boost directement dans le circuit principal. Résultat, jusqu’à trois fois plus de gain qu’un HM-2 classique, des palm mutes d’une précision redoutable et un volume de sortie colossal. Pour garder un signal propre malgré une telle puissance, Lichtlærm a inclus son noise gate Blackmer-VCA complet, intégré directement au circuit et utilisable même avec la boucle d’effets. Cette boucle parallèle, avec inversion de phase possible, ouvre la porte à toutes les expérimentations. Mixez la distorsion Medusa avec un overdrive, un préampli à lampes ou laissez-la vide pour obtenir un blend clair. Côté tonalité, l’égalisation conserve les célèbres bandes « low » et « grind », mais ajoute un médium paramétrique (200–700 Hz) et un contrôle de présence pour sculpter un son aussi rugueux que précis. Avec ses deux étages de gain commutables, vous pouvez alterner entre la saturation brute et râpeuse du HM-2 original et une distorsion moderne, incisive et centrée sur les médiums. Compacte, robuste et magnifiquement décorée d’un visuel en “or vérirable” signé Kasia Jasmina, la Medusa est la pédale ultime pour faire rugir pour faire flipper vos voisins. reassurence UNE ÉQUIPE PALF POUR VOUS SERVIR LIVRAISON OFFERTE EN POINT RELAIS DÈS 49€ D’ACHATS RETOURS GRATUITS EN FRANCE SOUS 30 JOURS LIVRAISON EXPRESS AVEC CHRONOPOST   Description --> Fiche technique Media Avis Questions tension d'alimentation :
